label: External cause of a composite
resolution: The new model separates numerical distinction from nonparthood. The q3 model of external esse-cause requires a distinct actual cause, not a cause outside all parts. The necessary-being survey uses a stronger outside-thing-and-parts condition. Neither is silently identified with a generic candidate relation here. A universal material fusion excludes material nonpart candidates within its covered domain, not distinct internal causes or nonmaterial causes in a larger domain. No direct q3 or survey-premise refutation is inferred.
